My work combines interaction design, accessibility, design systems, and full-stack engineering to reduce complexity and create experiences people can use with confidence. I enjoy solving problems at the intersection of human behavior and technology, from relationship-focused mobile applications to learning platforms and decision-support tools.
Currently preparing for graduate study in Human–Computer Interaction while pursuing UX Engineering and Product Engineering opportunities.

I focus on the engineering side of good products: clean architecture, measurable performance, and testing that lets teams ship with confidence.
